title: Trip to Hanoi and Sapa in Vietnam
highlights: Explore various landmarks of Vietnam as you go on a sightseeing tour such as Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple, and the Old Quarter.
Visit Cat Cat Village, known for its H'mong ethnic community and scenic surroundings.
Take a cable car ride to Fansipan Mountain, the highest peak in Indochina, for panoramic views.
Journey through Hanoi to Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and enjoy activities like swimming, kayaking, and cave visits.
overview:
About the Activity:
Fixed departure: Everyday
Partake in an incredible 5 day trip through the Vietnamese countrysides; explore Hanoi as well as Sapa during the trip.
Start the trip from Hanoi and tread through the most scenic paths of very remote villages and hilly regions.
Trek along the green valleys of Sapa, visit some ethnic tribal villages and also the first capital of Vietnam that is Hoa Lu.
Moreover, delight in an invigorating boat tour of Tam Coc which displays a number of beautiful caves, paddy fields and serene locations.
The package includes food, accommodation, airport transfers and transportation during the trip.
inclusions: Transfer from Noi Bai International Airport
3 nights stay in Hanoi with breakfast
1 night stay in Sa Pa with breakfast
Cat Cat Village Half-day Tour on a Shared basis
Fansipan Mountain Tour on a Shared basis
1 night stay in Halong Bay with breakfast
Halong Bay Overnight Cruise and ticket
Halong Bay to Hanoi and ticket
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: All visitors are required to carry valid ID proof.
Meals in the restaurants or cafes are nor included.
Please be aware that the package does not cover the cost of the visa, which must be obtained separately.
Travel insurance is not included in the package.
Kindly note that personal expenses are not included in the package and should be budgeted separately.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi
days.desc: Welcome to Hanoi, the vibrant capital of Vietnam! Upon your arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel in the city. After checking in, take some time to relax, before exploring the place at your own pace. You can visit Hoan Kiem Lake, the symbol of Hanoi, and Ngoc Son Temple for its cultural significance. Enjoy your evening at leisure and overnight stay at your hotel in Hanoi.

days.title: Transfer to Sa Pa | Cat Cat Village Tour
days.desc: Check-out from your hotel and get ready to go on a scenic drive to Sa Pa, an amazing town located in the Hoang Lien Son Mountains. The journey will take you through beautiful landscapes of terraced rice fields, lush valleys, and ethnic minority villages. Upon arrival in Sa Pa, check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the charming town or relaxing. Later, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Visit to Fansipan Mountain
days.desc: Begin your day with a visit to Fansipan Mountain, the highest peak in Indochina, often referred to as the "Roof of Indochina." You will take a cable car ride to the summit, enjoying panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. At the top, you can visit the impressive Fansipan Pagoda and take in the breathtaking scenery. After your descent, return to Sa Pa, to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.desc: Enjoy a leisurely morning in Sapa. You may explore the town on your own or relax at your hotel. In the afternoon, board the transfer back to Hanoi. Upon reaching your hotel in Hanoi, check-in and have an overnight stay at the hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Enjoy the Overnight Cruise
days.desc: In the morning, check-out from your hotel and depart for Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its emerald waters and limestone karsts. Upon arrival at the port, board your luxury cruise ship and begin your overnight journey through the bay. In the afternoon, participate in activities such as kayaking, swimming, or visiting a cave. In the evening, savour a delicious dinner on board and relax under the starlit sky.

items.title: Check-in at Halong Royal Palace Cruise
Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
items.desc:
Board the cruise for Halong Bay from Tuan Chao Harbor and check-in into your cabin. Enjoy the view from the cruise while as you are greeted with a welcome drink. 
You will visit the Ti Top island and enjoy the view of many more of Halong Bay's beautiful islands.
Explore Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy water activities like Kayaking and swimming in the bay. 
Return to the cruise and later, join the cooking demonstration on Vietnamese food by a talented chef. 
Enjoy an overnight stay at the cruise.

days.title: Transfer from Halong Bay to Hanoi
days.desc: Wake up early to witness a beautiful sunrise over Halong Bay. Enjoy a light breakfast and continue your cruise, exploring more of the bay's natural wonders. After brunch, disembark from the cruise and transfer back to Hanoi. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure. Later have an overnight stay at your hotel in Hanoi.

items.title: Halong Bay to Hanoi
items.desc:
Enjoy your journey by joining the Tai Chi lesson on the cruise. Explore the other parts and islands of the Halong Bay. 
Experience a boat ride to the Surprise Cave, the largest caves in the Halong Bay and admire it's scenic beauty. 
Return to the cruise, relax and enjoy before reaching Taun Chan Bay

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Check-out from your hotel and transfer to Noi Bai International Airport for your departure flight. Bid farewell to Vietnam, taking with you unforgettable memories of your journey.
